# Format: VEC|tag|platform|format|width|height|hex(inline input)|hex(platform blob)|hex(expected output),
# or ERR|tag|platform|format|width|height|hex(inline input)|hex(platform blob)|<InnerException type>.
# Reference-runtime differential: probe Temp/opencode/texplatprobe driving live
# Texture2D assets (`Texture2D.Create` over `ProcessedAssetCollection`, SDK 10.0.401).
# Rows pin the inline-data orchestration: Xbox360 swaps only the seven listed layouts
# (copying first, so the input array is never mutated), RGBA32/RGB24 pass through by
# reference, off-Switch platforms ignore the blob, short blobs and Switch2 (48) pass
# through, odd swap counts throw `IndexOutOfRangeException`, empty input stays empty,
# and Switch unswizzles the one-GOB RGBA32 layout plus the RGB24 conversion.
# Blob-version note from the same probe: `Has_PlatformBlob_C28` is false on 2020.1
# and older, true on 2020.2+ (all rows below ran on 2022.3 assets).
